{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' from string to float, handling commas
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders (exclude refunded)
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Identify test orders: revenue == 0.00 and converted == 0
# These are likely internal test orders or failed transactions
test_orders = completed_orders[(completed_orders['revenue'] == 0.00) & (completed_orders['converted'] == 0)]

# Exclude test orders from completed orders
valid_completed = completed_orders.drop(test_orders.index)

# Calculate total revenue from valid completed orders
total_revenue = valid_completed['revenue'].sum()

print("Total revenue from COMPLETED orders, excluding internal test orders:", total_revenue)"}
